entities.name: Maria Angélica
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maria Angélica Gonçalves da Silva, commonly known as Branca, is a Brazilian former basketball player. She was born in Osvaldo Cruz, Brazil. Branca played as a guard and stood 5 feet 7 inches tall, weighing 150 pounds. She represented Brazil in the 1996 Summer Olympics and won a team silver medal.
